title: Custom transformer protected reference solution and review guide
answer: A strong submission for Custom transformer should complete this objective: Develop and test a reusable transformer. It should demonstrate the expected outcome (Apply estimator conventions.), use a consistent and reproducible setup, report evidence rather than speculation, and address the limitation: Test cloneability, output shape, parameter behavior, and train-only state.
explanation: Review the result for technical correctness and reproducibility. The automatic check only looks for BaseEstimator, TransformerMixin, fit( and does not run the learner code. Test cloneability, output shape, parameter behavior, and train-only state.
